touches.text: Unix sockets carry the bus inside a Linux box. Between boxes, and on Windows, it is TCP: Python on Windows has no AF_UNIX (measured 2026-11-04, akiendell: the web server died on `socket.AF_UNIX`), and buses on two boxes (5.4.2.8.1) can only reach each other over the network. (Akien 2026-11-04, "yes please")
Publishes a client tool (connect, read, write, query ...) that talks to the database over its socket, no bus hop: faster (2.2.8.1.1).
Postgres itself: a host service, installed and upgraded by Recovery (7.3.5); Rescue when it won't start (7.5.3.2).
A remote box keeps its own database and syncs it with the one on akiendelllinux: the local copy is fast, and the sync is the backup. (Akien 2026-11-04)
